mandatory_wave_protocol: verify worktree and branch and read committed program documents, dispatch documents, and immediately preceding committed ACK
inspect current assignments, ACKs, and repository evidence for other-LLM conflicts and record resolutions
change only authorized paths and update only the wave's own ACK
run wave-specific gates and git diff --check
commit only authorized paths and push the exact commit to origin/fix/package10-final-20260725
record the full commit SHA, pushed ref, gates, conflicts, and coordinator decision in the ACK
transfer ownership only after coordinator confirmation of the committed ACK and pushed SHA

waves.scope: retire old runtime, routes, feature roots, shells, navigation, loader, alternate legacy visuals, and 18 legacy visual specs while preserving canonical routes and reusable nonvisual/API/domain behavior
waves.entry_checkpoint: committed recovery documents and coordinator-checkpointed ODP-P10-PROGRAM-RECOVERY-001 ACK
waves.exit_checkpoint: retirement gates pass and own ACK is coordinator-reviewed, committed, pushed, and records exact SHA

forbidden: parallel start before R3A ownership transfer
waves.entry_checkpoint: committed and pushed passing R3A ACK plus coordinator ownership transfer
waves.exit_checkpoint: product gates pass and own ACK is coordinator-reviewed, committed, pushed, and records exact SHA

waves.scope: API/security contract re-verification with fail-closed permissions, tenant boundaries, source policy, self-review denial, idempotency, version conflict, audit/WORM evidence, and promotion
waves.entry_checkpoint: committed and pushed passing R3B ACK plus coordinator ownership transfer
waves.exit_checkpoint: API/security gates pass and own ACK is coordinator-reviewed, committed, pushed, and records exact SHA

waves.scope: canonical E2E assertion and responsive coverage alignment for the implemented Package 10 runtime

waves.entry_checkpoint: committed and pushed passing CAN-002-R3 ACK plus coordinator ownership transfer
waves.exit_checkpoint: canonical coverage gates pass and own ACK is coordinator-reviewed, committed, pushed, and records exact SHA

waves.exit_checkpoint: all declared Chromium tests pass unchanged and own ACK is coordinator-reviewed, committed, pushed, and records exact SHA
